description_en: Queries the pool information corresponding to a data plan credential
description_zh: 查询套餐凭证对应的池信息
name: GetCredentialPoolStatistics

parameters.help_en: The month for which to query the data plan traffic usage details
parameters.help_zh: 要查询的套餐流量使用详情的月份
parameters.name: date

parameters.help_en:
The data plan credential. You can obtain it by using one of the following methods:

Log on to the IoT SIM Service console (https://dyiotnext.console.aliyun.com/?spm=a2c4g.11186623.0.0.6a072d25p4pUg8) and view the credential on the Data Plan Credentials page.

Call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/374328.html operation and view the credential (CredentialNo) in the response parameters
parameters.help_zh:
套餐凭证。获取方法如下：

在物联网SIM服务控制台 (https://dyiotnext.console.aliyun.com/?spm=a2c4g.11186623.0.0.6a072d25p4pUg8)的套餐凭证页面，查看套餐凭证。

调用接口https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/374328.html，在返回参数中查看套餐凭证（CredentialNo）
parameters.name: credential_no

Code.description_en:
The response code.

200: The call is successful.
Other values: An error code is returned. For more information about error codes, see [Error codes]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/375339.html）
Code.description_zh:
接口返回码。

200：表示成功。
其它：表示错误码。错误码详情，请参见[错误码]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/375339.html）

Data.description_en: The data plan traffic usage details

CardActiveNum.description_en: The number of active SIM cards in the data plan. Active SIM cards are those that are activated, not suspended, and not canceled
CardActiveNum.description_zh: 套餐内的生效卡数（已激活且未停机未销户）

CardTotalNum.description_en: The total number of SIM cards in the data plan

CredentialType.description_en:
The type of the data plan credential.

Single-card plan example: CT-SC-M-1-30M (Carrier-Plan type-Plan cycle-Tariff version-Data package tier).

Same-tier pool plan example: CM-SF-M-3-100M (Carrier-Plan type-Plan cycle-Tariff version-Data package tier).

Unified payment pool plan example: CU-UPG-M-2-Pool number (Carrier-Plan type-Plan cycle-Tariff version-Pool number)
CredentialType.description_zh:
套餐凭证类型。

单卡套餐示例：CT-SC-M-1-30M（运营商-套餐类型-套餐周期-资费版本-流量包档位）。

同档位池套餐示例：CM-SF-M-3-100M（运营商-套餐类型-套餐周期-资费版本-流量包档位）。

统付池套餐示例：CU-UPG-M-2-池编号（运营商-套餐类型-套餐周期-资费版本-池编号）

EffectiveAvailableFlow.description_en: The available traffic balance in the data plan. This parameter is displayed only for same-tier pool plans
EffectiveAvailableFlow.description_zh: 套餐内可用余量，仅同档位池套餐显示该参数

EffectiveTotalFlow.description_en: The total traffic of the data plan. This parameter is displayed only for same-tier pool plans
EffectiveTotalFlow.description_zh: 套餐总流量，仅同档位池套餐显示该参数

MonthExceedFee.description_en:
The number of feature fee units that exceed the plan limit in the current month.

A value greater than 0 indicates that the feature fee has exceeded the plan limit. A value of 0 or null indicates that the feature fee has not exceeded the plan limit
MonthExceedFee.description_zh:
当月功能费超套份数。

大于0代表功能费已超套；等于0或null代表未超套

MonthFeatureFee.description_en: The number of monthly feature fee units. This parameter is displayed only for unified payment pool plans
MonthFeatureFee.description_zh: 月功能费份数，仅统付池套餐显示该参数

MonthUsedAmount.description_en: The total traffic used in the month

PoolAvaiable.description_en: The available traffic balance in the data plan. This parameter is displayed only for unified payment pool plans
PoolAvaiable.description_zh: 套餐内可用余量，仅统付池套餐显示该参数

PoolGrandTotal.description_en: The total traffic of the data plan. This parameter is displayed only for unified payment pool plans
PoolGrandTotal.description_zh: 套餐总流量，仅统付池套餐显示该参数

PoolGrandTotalUsed.description_en: The total traffic used for the data plan. This parameter is displayed only for unified payment pool plans
PoolGrandTotalUsed.description_zh: 套餐流量使用总量，仅统付池套餐显示该参数

PoolOutUsed.description_en: The out-of-plan traffic used in the current month

PoolUsed.description_en: The traffic used in the current month

ErrorMessage.description_en: The error message returned if the call fails
ErrorMessage.description_zh: 调用失败时，返回的出错信息

RequestId.description_zh: 请求ID，阿里云为该请求生成的标识符

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the call was successful.

true: The call was successful.

false: The call failed
Success.description_zh:
是否调用成功。

true：调用成功。

false：调用失败
